identity: Sunscar lives by its wells; boars, rats, husks and a band of very confused water thieves all want a drink first.

quests.title: A Drink Too Far
quests.text: Small Boars are ripping our waterskins in the {name:wellfields}, {dir_of:sunscar:wellfields}. Kill eight by day; their yellow names mean they wait for you to strike first. Make that first blow count.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls.

quests.title: Hides Are Not Bedding
quests.text: Kill eight Large Dust Rats in the {name:wellfields} after dark; they are chewing the clan's drying hides into bedding. Their red names mean they come at you on sight, so keep your feet under you.
quests.lesson: Night rosters differ from day ones; red names attack on sight.

quests.title: Earn Your Breath
quests.text: The clan's cooking fires need feeding, and your hunting arm needs work. Bring down eight Young Plains Runners by day in the {name:runner_plains}, {zone_area:runner_plains}. Save the boasting for when you catch your breath.

quests.title: Let the Thirst End
quests.text: Even death has not quenched the Sluggish Sun-Dried Husks that wander the {name:saltflats} at night, {dir_from_giver:saltflats}. Put eight to rest before they reach our wells. Whatever they were, they have crawled through enough salt.

quests.title: The Last Drop Is Ours
quests.text: We share water with any thirsty stranger; the Confused Water Thieves took that for weakness. Strike the {name:thieves_camp} {dir_from_giver:thieves_camp} and kill six of them and {name:water_thief_chief} himself. Let Sunscar fill its cups without looking over its shoulder.
quests.lesson: Camps hold several enemies; pull the edge, then the chief.

quests.title: Carry Sunscar With You
quests.text: You have earned a place at our fire, even when your boots carry you beyond it. Follow the road from Sunscar to Redtusk Village and speak to Borak Redgrass. Tell him Gara Stonevoice trusts your hands; he can judge your boasting for himself.

quests.title: Bounty: A Thirst for Trouble
quests.text: Every Confused Water Thief who wanders into the {name:thieves_camp} thinks the last lot merely lacked talent. Kill six and return for the clan's bounty. You can take the job again twenty minutes after collecting your pay; apparently the supply of fools needs less time.

quests.title: Put Those Hands to Work
quests.text: A clan needs hands that can build as well as break. Make one Wooden Axe and one Wooden Pickaxe, then bring both to me. I will give them back after a look; I have enough tools and too many idle pupils.
quests.lesson: Basic tools; handed-in tools come back as the reward.

quests.title: Leave the Splinters Behind
quests.text: Still pulling splinters out? Then you have learned what wood can do. Bring me one Stone Axe and one Stone Pickaxe for inspection. I will return both, ready for your next lesson.

quests.title: A Lesson in the Coals
quests.text: The ground keeps its good things buried; make it yield some. Mine copper and tin beneath the flats, smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars, and bring them here. I will give you a Dual Furnace so you can turn the two metals into bronze.

quests.title: Let Bronze Do the Talking
quests.text: Bring me three Bronze Bars from your furnace, and I will put a Bronze Pickaxe in your hands. The rocks beyond Sunscar have ignored some very fine threats; take something they will listen to.

quests.title: Supper Has Too Many Legs
quests.text: Supper is scuttling about on the {name:strand}, {dir_from_giver:strand}, and I have a pot to mind. Hunt Small Crabs there by day and bring me three Crab Legs. Their yellow names mean they wait for the first hit, which is more courtesy than I get from hungry hunters.

quests.title: Keep Dinner Off the Dirt
quests.text: Bring me three Fine Sinew from the Young Plains Runners that graze the {name:runner_plains} by day. My drying rack needs new bindings before it drops supper into the dirt, and those runners are too quick for an old cook with a ladle.

quests.title: Grandmother's Fire
quests.text: My grandmother's grandmother tended the Long Fire. Every cook since has kept it fed. Bring me five logs from any tree outside town. You can tell your grandchildren you helped; leave out how much I had to ask.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not.

quests.title: Give the Oven a Roar
quests.text: This oven is sulking, and shouting at it only gets ash in my teeth. Mine five Coal Lumps from the stone around Sunscar and bring them here. We have a clan to feed before anyone starts gnawing the ladle.

quests.title: A Bowl You Earned
quests.text: Hear those stomachs growling louder than the hunters' stories? Bring me ten pieces of Raw Meat from your hunts. I will cook a share for you too; nobody who feeds this fire leaves it hungry.
